text:
Sam (eng): Quick heads-up  Datadog QA wants an "acceptance smoke" for the marketplace tile. We need a deterministic checklist + tiny demo that SIs can run locally.
Priya S: Good call. Partner kit should include: 1) OTLP config snippet, 2) dashboard JSON (templated), 3) minimal runbook with firewall + KMS notes, 4) a 3-min demo video.
Vik: I'll own the smoke checklist items. propose: connectivity, tag mapping, sampling, buffer/flush, and dashboard import. Each should be runnable in <5 commands.
Marta: i'll make the templated dashboard and a short README for marketplace. Dashboard must show p95 by model tag, token-cost by model_version, and a trace table. Keep JSON small.
Sam (eng): OTLP snippet we'll include (demo cluster):
```yaml
exporters:
  otlp/datadog:
    endpoint: "https://otlp.datadoghq.com:4317"
    headers:
      DD_API_KEY: "<REDACTED>"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      exporters: [otlp/datadog]
```
Sam (eng): runtime flags for demo: REDWOOD_TRACE_ENRICH=true, REDWOOD_TRACE_SAMPLE_RATE=0.01 (1% for prompt_id). will add a note about cardinality.
Vik: checklist item examples:
- `curl -f https://otlp.datadoghq.com:4317` (connectivity)
- Ensure model->tag mapping present in traces
- Import dashboard JSON into dd UI
- Toggle sample rate to 0.5 then 100% for capture test
- Simulate Datadog outage and verify buffer-to-disk forwards on recovery
Marta: for marketplace we must include an embargoed screenshot and a short legal blurb. tagging @Priya S to coordinate.
Priya S: will draft the marketplace copy and the partner email. add a 2-line FAQ: data residency and PII guidance.
Ops-bot: preflight-check: staging OTLP reachable from demo cluster  PASS
Datadog-bot: dashboard-validate: widgets ok, tag usage within recommended limits  OK
Sam (eng): runbook note for onprem air-gapped path: create export bundle and provide `rdw-forward --bundle /tmp/dd-bundle.tar.gz --dest /var/lib/redwood/trace-buffer` for SI to run.
Vik: timeline: prototypes by Fri EOD, dry-run next Tue. I'll create the smoke script and add it to partner repo.
Marta: will compress dashboard JSON and include import instructions. aiming for a <150KB payload.
Priya S: thanks. i'll schedule a 20m sync for Tue to sign off the kit and record the 3-min clip. calendar invite incoming. :calendar:
